measured.note: the score's MIDI and its own engineering render agree at 0.714, which bounds what any cross-modal number can mean: a round trip through audio through one caricature voice already costs 0.29.

metric_correction: The first scalar divided the common subsequence by the longer side, so deleting material shrank its own denominator and a four-minute edit outscored the untouched recording. Coverage of each side is now reported separately and combined harmonically, and completeness is a distinct criterion rather than folded into one number.

transposition.why: recurrence is pitch-relative, so a globally transposed piece has the same form. That is correct behaviour for a form measure and means transposition must be decided by the tonal profile instead.

truncation_and_coda_removal.where_it_belongs: the audio side alone: terminal fade, macro-boundary census and duration against the declared edition, all of which already detect truncation without consulting the score
truncation_and_coda_removal.why: The score is far shorter than the record -- it accounts for roughly 44 percent of it, established before any audio was compared. A radio edit is therefore CLOSER to the score's length than the full version is, and every length-based measure prefers the edit. This is not a defect in the ratio; it follows from the score's coverage, and no reweighting fixes it.

material_substitution.evidence: replacing one repeated span with unrelated material drops 0.588 to 0.500

section_reordering.evidence: shuffling two macro sections is the largest drop measured, 0.588 to 0.476

tempo_change.evidence: a moderate time stretch leaves agreement unchanged at 0.588, because both sides are quantized to their own pulse

unrelated_music.evidence: Bach's BWV 846 prelude returns not comparable rather than a number, because it carries no repeated material at all

state.reason: qualification is partial by construction: this instrument decides ordering and substitution, and truncation belongs elsewhere. Freezing it as though it decided everything would repeat the mistake the harmonic comparator made.

supersedes: the harmonic comparator, which could not localize form in a four-chord loop and was landed unfrozen and unqualified
what_changed: The score side is now the v2 performed MIDI rather than chord symbols, so both sides go through the same source reader and are compared on recurrence -- which bars are like which other bars -- instead of on harmonic content.
